scope: Mounted Golden Plains Horse hind-leg articulation v1
problem: Native thigh lift reaches 139 degrees and pulls the weighted hindquarters upward while riding; reported during both normal riding and gallop.
method: Mount-only profile adapter softly limits forward femur lift to 55 degrees, retains the native lateral hip/stifle offset and solves the serial hock/fetlock chain back to the authored contact. Fetlock/hoof world orientation is restored exactly.

preservation.runtimeActorScope: Mounted horse only; ordinary horse NPCs and Moor Pony retain their existing motion
preservation.unchanged: Source motion timing, hooves/soles, body/front-leg/tail motion, saddle, rider, reins, cape and controls.

soleAudit.note: All certified sole vertices are wholly owned by joints whose world transforms are preserved.

gates.sourceAuthoring: Runtime articulation only; native anatomy, serial chain and sole ownership audited. No geometry or rig export.
gates.exportFidelity: Not applicable: source GLB, skin, bind/rest and native animation channels are unchanged.
gates.godotIntegration: 480 Hz full-cycle native playback, authored contacts, segment lengths, unaffected joints, loops and no pole flips pass; equipped rider and action regressions pass.
gates.visualReview: Full cycles rendered at 30 FPS from side, rear and gameplay camera, with cape. Sampled phases and before/after pose sheets inspected.
gates.userApproval: Pending user review of corrected mounted hind-leg motion.

limitations: Artistic quality of the revised mounted motion awaits user approval. This change does not revise unmounted creature animation.
